title: feat(lint)!: report a searchableFields entry that names a secret or password field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiEosMC3zDfHaauURHFNq1GJ)_

Fixes #27705

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #27660

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `os validate`、`os build` 和元数据发布门现在把 `searchableFields` 里指向 `secret` / `password` 字段的条目报为错误(沿用规则 `searchable-field-unsearchable`),对象自身集合、列表视图、React 页面 ListView 组件的 `searchableFields` 属性 全覆盖。
- **为什么改:** 引擎搜索时会静默跳过凭据字段,作者声明的搜索范围悄悄变窄;全是凭据字段时还会退回自动默认集。现在写的时候就告诉作者,严重级别与 `formula` 条目一致。
- **风险与回滚:** 这是收窄:以前能通过的元数据现在会报错。仓内没有这样的元数据(dogfood 全绿)。引擎行为不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts`(新增的凭据检查段,位于 formula 检查之后、可接受性检查之前)、`packages/spec/src/data/masked-field-types.ts`(新谓词 `isCredentialFieldType`)、`packages/objectql/src/secret-fields.ts`(一行替换,行为不变)。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-searchable-fields.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中包括 "a secret or password entry" 这一组。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

Independent review: none run (quota); the PR waits for the seat's contract-review hand-off.

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts`.** A credential check sits beside the `formula` check from #6674. It reports a `searchableFields` entry whose field type is `secret` or `password` under `searchable-field-unsearchable` at `error`. It runs on every surface the virtual check covers: the object's own set, an object's built-in list views, `defineView` lists and named list views, a flattened list overlay, a ViewItem record, and a react page's ListView `searchableFields` prop (through the shared `checkSearchableFieldList` core). The remedy line is `Drop "NAME": credential fields are never searched`. The module note (check 4) gives the reason for the severity. The check runs before the #4830 admissibility pass, so a view over an auto-default object gets this verdict instead of the generic "of type 'password'… target a text-like field".
- **`packages/spec/src/data/masked-field-types.ts`.** Adds `isCredentialFieldType(fieldType)`. It answers whether a type is masked on read on at least one object, which today means `secret` and `password`. It reads that from the keys of `MASKED_ON_READ_FIELD_TYPES`, so it adds no second type literal, and it ignores the better-auth exemption. `isMaskedOnReadFieldType` now uses it for its own-key test, and its answers are unchanged.
- **`packages/objectql/src/secret-fields.ts`.** `collectCredentialFields` now reads `isCredentialFieldType` instead of its own `def.type === 'secret' || def.type === 'password'` literal. This is the one-line swap the order allows. The linter and the engine's search withhold (`expandSearchOnAst`, unchanged) now judge credential types from one predicate. `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` is not touched.
- **`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`.** `os explain searchable-field-unsearchable` gains a paragraph on what the engine does with a credential entry on each surface, why there is no exemption, and why the finding is an error.
- **`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`.** Regenerated by `check:generated --fix` (one line each, the new export).
- **`.changeset/27705-searchable-credential-fields.md`.** `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/objectql` patch. It carries both declaration lines and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition, the precedent of `27225-mail-formatter-shape-lint.md`.

## Tests

- `validate-searchable-fields.test.ts`: `secret` and `password` on the object's own set, and on a list view narrowing (it.each). Also a view entry the object itself declares (both findings), a better-auth `password` (exemption-free), a control where text and email entries in the same declarations stay clean, and the `os explain` text. The `fix:`-line coverage control adds the credential arm.
- `validate-react-page-props.test.ts`: a ListView `searchableFields={['name', 'api_key', 'portal_password']}` prop reports both credential entries at `error`.
- `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`: the object publish door refuses `searchableFields: ['owner', 'api_key']` (`api_key` is `secret`).
- `masked-field-types.test.ts`: `isCredentialFieldType` over every `FieldType`, its agreement with "masked on some object", the one cell where it and `isMaskedOnReadFieldType` differ (`password` × better-auth), and unvalidated input.

## Acceptance notes

- **Severity.** `error`, the severity the triage ruling sets (the same as the #6674 `formula` entry). Hence `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.
- **Predicate home.** No credential-type predicate existed in `packages/spec`. `SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_TYPES` also lists `json`, `lookup` and other types an author may declare, and `isMaskedOnReadFieldType` applies the better-auth exemption that the search withhold does not apply. So the predicate was added next to the mask table it reads.
- **Observed, not measured (not filed).** The REST ingress (`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`) admits a `$searchFields` entry naming a credential field that the object itself declares, and the engine then withholds it. Reading `resolveSearchFields`, a request naming only such fields would be answered over the object's whole allowed set. That is a narrower request answered more widely. This is a reading of the code, not a measurement through a public door, so it is left here for the seat. It sits outside this card's "no runtime change" scope.
- **Skills.** #27660 teaches `searchableFields should not list it` in `skills/objectstack-data`. The boundary table in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, which lists each `searchable-field-unsearchable` row, has no credential row. #27660 could take that row as well. This PR touches no `skills/**` file.
- **Ablation.** Run once against the committed fix, not kept as a test.
